description: Access MINDsense — the user's live emotional state, signal history, spikes and emotionally-weighted entities, derived from valence/arousal signal processing rather than asked directly. Reach for this before a sensitive conversation, when deciding how hard to push on a topic, or when asked "how am I feeling" / "read the room"; reach for mind_query instead for factual history about what happened. Actions: state (current snapshot), signals (recent raw signals), timeline (historical trend), kg_weights (which entities carry emotional weight), spikes (notable events, some unacknowledged), acknowledge (clear a spike), summary (AI-written recap). No signals in the lookback window means nothing was captured in that period, not that the user was neutral — widen `days` before concluding calm.

action.description: Action: state (current emotion), signals (recent signals), timeline (historical), kg_weights (emotionally weighted entities), spikes (recent spikes), acknowledge (ack a spike), summary (AI emotional summary)

name: mind_sense
